decisions.reason: After only one year on the market, a LED track spotlight in a core adjacent category still has unresolved demand potential and is relatively cheap to keep listed, so the option value of waiting remains higher than the case for abandonment.

A LED ceiling luminaire is close to the firm's established lighting business and, with no clear negative signal yet, management would usually keep the product another year because uncertainty is still resolving and the cost of continuation is likely modest.
